summary: Jupiter Neurosciences filed an 8-K regarding a registered direct offering of 7,142,858 common shares at $0.28/share for ~$2.0M gross proceeds, via a shelf takedown under an existing S-3. No premium, board recommendation, or structural special situation is present; it is a standard equity financing. D. Boral Capital acted as placement agent with a 7% cash fee. The deal is expected to close shortly with customary conditions. As a routine capital raise (shelf takedown), this filing does not constitute a special situation.
